sections.heading: Formalised on paper does not always mean formalised in practice.
prose: Self-help groups, cooperatives, table banking groups, faith-based networks and MSMEs form the backbone of Kenya’s grassroots economy. Most remain trapped in informality — not by choice, but by structural friction in the systems meant to formalise them.

Fewer than 10% of community groups, and fewer than 5% of county social services directorates, are even aware the Community Groups Registration Act 2022 exists. And where registration does happen, it rarely converts into real market access: no separation of personal and business finances, no usable transaction history, no route into structured buyers or financial products.

**Solving one problem without the other fails groups either way.** A group that is formalised but stagnant has gained a certificate and nothing else. A group with market access but no registration cannot use it.

sections.heading: From an informal circle of trust to a bankable enterprise.

media.alt: The path from an informal group to a bankable enterprise: group forms, registers, gets KRA & eTIMS, becomes bankable

prose: Formalisation only becomes empowerment when it is fast, affordable, and immediately followed by usable market and financial access. Each stage reduces friction at the point where groups currently stall.
ticks: **Registration** lets a group open an account and hold property in its own name.
**Tax compliance** — a KRA PIN and simplified eTIMS onboarding — lets the group invoice, supply and bid for tenders.
**Internal dispute resolution** keeps a group functioning through the conflict that pooled money inevitably produces.
**Staged financial literacy** unlocks negotiated savings, credit and insurance products designed for group realities.

sections.heading: We do not issue anything ourselves.
sections.lead: Every certificate, licence or account a group ends up holding comes from the institution with the legal mandate to issue it. CECF is lead applicant and implementing partner — our contribution is grassroots trust, reach and delivery experience, sequenced into a single pathway.
